sentences.en: JOHN: Erm ... hello Professor, I'm John Wishart
sentences.zh: JOHN: 呃……您好，教授，我是约翰·威沙特。

sentences.en: I'm working on my entry for the Global Design Competition
sentences.zh: 我正在为全球设计大赛准备我的参赛作品。

sentences.en: My tutor said you might be able to help me with it
sentences.zh: 我的导师说您或许能在这方面给予我一些帮助。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Ah, yes, got a copy of your drawings
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 啊，是的，我已收到您图纸的副本。

sentences.en: Come in and tell me about it
sentences.zh: 请进，跟我讲讲您的设计吧。

sentences.en: What sort of competition is it?
sentences.zh: 这是一项什么样的比赛？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, it's an international design competition and we have to come up with a new design for a typical domestic kitchen appliance
sentences.zh: JOHN: 嗯，这是一场国际性设计大赛，我们需为一种典型的家用厨房电器提出全新设计方案。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: I see, and are there any special conditions?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 明白了，那么有没有什么特别的要求？

sentences.en: Does it have to save energy for example?
sentences.zh: 例如，是否必须具备节能功能？

sentences.en: JOHN: Actually that was the focus in last year's competition
sentences.zh: JOHN: 实际上，节能正是去年比赛的重点。

sentences.en: This year's different
sentences.zh: 而今年则有所不同。

sentences.en: We have to adopt an innovative approach to existing technology, using it in a way that hasn't been thought of before
sentences.zh: 我们必须对现有技术采取创新性的应用方式，即以一种前所未有的方式来使用该技术。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: I see, that sounds tricky
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 明白了，听起来颇有难度。

sentences.en: And what kitchen appliance have you chosen?
sentences.zh: 那么您选定的是哪一种厨房电器呢？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, I decided to choose the dishwasher
sentences.zh: JOHN: 我决定选择洗碗机。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Interesting, what made you choose that?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 很有意思，您为什么选它？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, they're an everyday kitchen appliance in most Australian houses but they're all pretty boring and almost identical to each other
sentences.zh: JOHN: 嗯，在大多数澳大利亚家庭中，洗碗机都是一种日常使用的厨房电器，但它们全都相当乏味，彼此之间几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: I think some people will be prepared to pay a little extra for something that looks different
sentences.zh: 我认为，有些人会愿意多花一点钱，购买一款外观独特的产品。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: That's a nice idea. see you've called your design 'the Rockpool'; why is that?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 这是个不错的创意。我看到您将这个设计命名为‘岩池’（the Rockpool），这是为什么？

sentences.en: JOHN: Basically because it looks like the rock pools you find on a beach
sentences.zh: JOHN: 基本上是因为它的外形酷似海滩上的潮汐池。

sentences.en: The top is made of glass so that you can look down into it
sentences.zh: 顶部采用玻璃材质，以便人们可以俯视内部。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: And there's stone at the bottom
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 底部还铺有石头。

sentences.en: Is that just for decoration?
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是为了装饰吗？

sentences.en: Test
sentences.zh: Test

sentences.en: JOHN: Actually it does have a function
sentences.zh: JOHN: 实际上，它还具有实际功能。

sentences.en: Instead of pushing a button, you turn the stone
sentences.zh: 您无需按按钮，只需转动这块石头即可。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: So it's a really just a novel way of starting the dishwasher
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 所以，这其实只是一种启动洗碗机的新颖方式。

sentences.en: JOHN: That's right
sentences.zh: JOHN: 没错。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: It's a really nice design, but what makes it innovative?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 这确实是一个非常出色的设计，但它的创新之处究竟在哪里？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, I decided to make a dishwasher that uses carbon dioxide
sentences.zh: JOHN: 我决定设计一款利用二氧化碳进行清洗的洗碗机。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: In place of water and detergent?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 那就是用二氧化碳替代水和洗涤剂？

sentences.en: How will you manage that?
sentences.zh: 您打算如何实现这一点？

sentences.en: JOHN: The idea is to pressurise the carbon dioxide so that it becomes a liquid
sentences.zh: JOHN: 其原理是将二氧化碳加压，使其变为液态。

sentences.en: The fluid is then released into the dishwasher where it cleans the dishes it all by itself
sentences.zh: 随后，这种液体被释放到洗碗机内，从而独立完成餐具的清洁工作。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Sounds like a brilliant idea!
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 听起来真是个绝妙的主意！

sentences.en: Your system will totally do away with the need for strong detergents
sentences.zh: 您的系统将彻底消除对强效洗涤剂的需求。

sentences.en: So what happens once the dishes are clean?
sentences.zh: 那么，餐具清洗完毕后又会发生什么？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, to allow them to dry, the liquid carbon dioxide and the waste materials all go to an area called the holding chamber
sentences.zh: JOHN: 为使餐具干燥，液态二氧化碳及各类废弃物将全部进入一个名为‘暂存室’的区域。

sentences.en: That's where the liquid is depressurised and so it reverts to a gas
sentences.zh: 在那里，液态二氧化碳将被减压，从而重新转化为气态。

sentences.en: Then the oil and grease are separated out and sent to the waste system
sentences.zh: 接着，油污和油脂将被分离出来，并排入废料处理系统。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: It sounds like you've thought it all out very thoroughly
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 听起来你已经把所有问题都考虑得非常周全了。

sentences.en: So, what happens to the carbon dioxide once the process is complete?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个过程完成之后，二氧化碳会怎样处理呢？

sentences.en: Not wasted I hope
sentences.zh: 希望不会被浪费掉。

sentences.en: JOHN: Actually, that's where the real savings are made
sentences.zh: JOHN: 实际上，真正的节能效果正是体现在这里。

sentences.en: The carbon dioxide is sent back to the cylinder and can be used again and again
sentences.zh: 二氧化碳会被送回气瓶中，可以反复使用。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: What a terrific idea
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 多么绝妙的主意啊！

sentences.en: Do you think it will ever be built?
sentences.zh: 你觉得它将来真的会被建造出来吗？

sentences.en: JOHN: Probably not, but that's OK
sentences.zh: JOHN: 很可能不会，但没关系。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Well, I'm sure a lot of positive things will come out of your design
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 嗯，我相信你的设计一定会带来许多积极成果。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Now, you seem to have thought about everything sO what exactly did you need me to help you with?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 现在，你似乎已将方方面面都考虑到了，那么你究竟需要我帮你解决什么问题呢？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, my design has made it to the final stage of the competition and, in a few months' time, I have to give a presentation, and that's the part I was
sentences.zh: JOHN: 嗯，我的设计方案已进入本次竞赛的最终阶段，几个月后，我需要做一个展示演讲，而这一部分正是我……

sentences.en: hoping you could help me with
sentences.zh: 希望能得到您帮助的地方。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Right, well that should be easy enough
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 好的，这应该不难。

sentences.en: What have you managed to do so far?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，你已经完成了哪些工作？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, I've got detailed drawings to show how it will work and I've also written a 500-word paper on it
sentences.zh: JOHN: 嗯，我已经绘制了详细的设计图，用以说明该设备的工作原理；此外，我还撰写了一篇500字的相关论文。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: see
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 明白了。

sentences.en: Well, if you want to stand a good chance of winning you really need a model of the machine
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你想赢得这次比赛，就真的需要制作一台机器的实体模型。

sentences.en: JOHN: Yes, I thought I might but I'm having a few problems
sentences.zh: JOHN: 是的，我也这么想过，但目前遇到了一些困难。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: What is the main difficulty so far?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 到目前为止，最主要的问题是什么？

sentences.en: Let me guess - is it the materials?
sentences.zh: 让我猜一猜——是不是材料的问题？

sentences.en: JOHN: Yes
sentences.zh: JOHN: 是的。

sentences.en: I want it to look professional but everything that's top quality is also
sentences.zh: 我希望模型看起来专业，但所有高品质的材料也都……

sentences.en: very expensive
sentences.zh: 非常昂贵。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Look, projects like this are very important to us
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 听着，像这样的项目对我们而言非常重要。

sentences.en: They really help lift our profile
sentences.zh: 它们确实能极大提升我们的知名度。

sentences.en: So why don't you talk to the university about a grant?
sentences.zh: 所以，你何不跟大学方面谈谈，申请一笔资助呢？

sentences.en: I can help you fill out the application forms if you like
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我可以帮你填写申请表格。

sentences.en: JOHN: That would be great
sentences.zh: JOHN: 那太好了。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: You'd better show me this paper you've written as well
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 你最好也把写好的那篇论文拿给我看看。

sentences.en: For a global competition such as this you need to make sure the technical details you've given are accurate and thorough
sentences.zh: 对于这种全球性竞赛而言，你必须确保所给出的技术细节准确无误且详尽充分。

sentences.en: JOHN: That would be a great help
sentences.zh: JOHN: 这将是非常大的帮助。

sentences.en: PROFESSOR: Is there anything else can do?
sentences.zh: PROFESSOR: 还有别的我能帮上忙的吗？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, I'm really
sentences.zh: JOHN: 嗯，我其实真的……
